note: The AI-marked text family — essay and diagram — plus the legacy `short` spelling, which is NOT in that family. `isTextAnswerType` covers short_answer/diagram/essay, so those three trust the marker's verdict on the answer object; `short` falls through to plain equality despite reading like a sibling. That asymmetry is the reason this fixture exists: it is invisible from the type name and would otherwise be discovered by a learner.
